runToken.description: A run claim token minted by POST /runs/claim.

put.summary: Create a work item (idempotent by client ULID)

201.description: Created. A replay of the same id and spec returns the existing item.

403.description: Principal may not request this pipeline

409.description: Item exists with a different spec

429.description: Fleet is at its live-run cap

get.description: Pages over native items newest-first. A response carrying `nextCursor` may still have more behind it -- pass that value back as `cursor` to continue. `state`/`principal`/`repo` filter each page after it is read, so an empty `items` array with a `nextCursor` present means "none on this page", not "no more pages" -- keep paging until `nextCursor` is absent to see every matching item (issue #1546).

post.summary: Mint a fresh run for a parked item

400.description: resumeSessionId does not name a resumable session for this item

403.description: Principal may not request this pipeline or repository

409.description: Only a parked item can be redispatched, or the named session has no archived transcript

429.description: Fleet is at its live-run cap

put.summary: Create a cron schedule (idempotent by client ULID)

201.description: Created. A replay of the same id, cron, and spec returns the existing schedule.

403.description: Principal may not request this pipeline

409.description: Schedule exists with a different cron or spec
